verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API described as the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without the web UI, which directly states UI parity. It is backed by a CLI for managing gates, experiments and dynamic configs (including in CI/CD), an HTTP API for evaluation and event logging, and an official MCP server. Missing for 10: endpoint-level coverage showing which console actions the API includes (e.g., metrics, access management, Warehouse Native), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on confirmation that parity holds in practice.
